prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A highly detailed, close-up shot of an ornate, fantasy-inspired dagger displayed against a smooth, dark gradient background. The knife features a faceted, crystalline blade that refracts light into a vivid spectrum of rainbow colors, creating a prismatic effect across its surface. The handle is intricately decorated with elaborate, swirling patterns and embedded with colorful gemstones, giving it a luxurious, almost regal appearance. The lighting is sharp and focused, emphasizing the reflective and translucent qualities of the blade and the metallic, jewel-encrusted handle. The overall style is hyper-realistic with a touch of surrealism, reminiscent of high-end product photography or digital concept art. The composition centers the dagger, with a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the background, drawing all attention to the exquisite craftsmanship and vibrant color play of the weapon.
